description: The file defines the interface for the engine controller module, including function declarations for initialization, voltage mock setters, and state printing, along with necessary includes and header guards.

methods.name: getPinNameByAdcChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the pin name associated with a specific ADC hardware channel and writes it into a buffer.

methods.name: initPeriodicEvents
methods.description: Initializes periodic engine events, parameters passed by macro.

methods.name: initEngineContoller
methods.description: Initializes the engine controller with logging and engine parameters.

methods.name: commonInitEngineController
methods.description: Performs common initialization routines for the engine controller.

methods.name: setMockVBattVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock voltage value for the battery voltage for testing.

methods.name: setMockMapVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock voltage value for the manifold absolute pressure sensor.

methods.name: setMockTpsVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock voltage for the throttle position sensor.

methods.name: setMockAfrVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock air-fuel ratio sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockMafVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock MAF sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockIatVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock intake air temperature sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockCltVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock coolant temperature sensor voltage.

methods.name: printCurrentState
methods.description: Prints the current engine state to the log.
